title: shutdown
description: Graceful stop request (spec §6.2). The plugin should finish in-flight work and close the socket before `deadline`. After it, the core sends SIGTERM and then SIGKILL.

deadline.description: Absolute, not a duration — a duration would start counting from whenever the plugin got round to reading the frame, which is exactly the case where the deadline matters.

reason.description: Why the core is stopping the plugin: `restart`, `upgrade`, `disable`, `core_shutdown`. Advisory; a plugin might use it to decide whether to persist state.
